summary: Comprehensive UI/UX testing of AIFund.com new features completed. All requested features working correctly: 1) Multi-language switcher (中文/EN) works perfectly with proper translations, 2) Landing page plain language copy verified (no GPT-5.2 jargon), 3) 5-step flow with updated Step 4 '跟随Bot' and Step 5 'Bot帮主人赚钱' text verified, 4) WalletGuideModal with 5 wallet options (MetaMask, OKX, Trust, Coinbase, Unisat) and external links working, 5) Demo mode loads dashboard correctly, 6) Bot Chat shows simplified daily buy/sell commands with '了解 XXX 详情' links, 7) VIP API Settings shows exchange registration '开户注册' and app download '下载APP' links for each market, 8) Mobile responsive at 390px width working properly, 9) Previous features (Global Vision, Bot Showcase) still working.

Code structure is clean with proper data-testid attributes
Multi-language implementation is well organized using translation object pattern
Mobile responsive design uses proper Tailwind breakpoints (sm:, md:, lg:)
test_credentials: Demo mode accessed via '免费体验演示' button - no credentials needed
seed_data_creation: Demo user auto-created with 100U deposit + bot creation
